assertions: The explicit provider-neutral adapter contract requires create, query, acknowledgement normalization, webhook normalization, reconciliation snapshot, health and stable error classification methods.
Every financial capability is declared explicitly and unsupported capabilities fail closed without silent simulation.
Adapter health is effect-free, network-free, mutation-free, money-free and production-denied.
Payment intent create/query replay is stable; payload drift and incomplete acknowledgement fail closed.
Sensitive payment fields, invalid signatures, expired signatures and parsed bodies without raw-body verification are rejected.
Exact provider event replay is deterministic; concurrent claims and event payload drift are rejected.
Out-of-order events are deferred and terminal states are protected.
Provider snapshots reconcile through A04 and deliberate divergences cannot trigger automatic resolution or money mutation.
Timeout, rate limit and provider unavailability are retryable only for idempotent operations; authentication, conflict, incomplete response and permanent failures remain blocked.

Staging readiness additionally requires immutable adapter version, controlled webhook endpoint, migration/deployment inventory, synthetic fixtures, zero-budget or sandbox mode, cleanup and sanitized evidence.
A ready plan remains non-executable by the repository contract and production is denied.
